title: TabDDPM-Aug
summary: A Python package/benchmark suite for tabular data augmentation that oversamples minority classes using deep generative models (TabDDPM plus GAN/VAE/copula baselines) and benchmarks their downstream ML performance; it calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with conditional sampling) as comparison baselines against its main TabDDPM-based augmentation method.
